scope: Common native Grid/layout, coordinate mapping, V/A/W/T, source composition and axis parity/donor geometry only. No axisymmetric fluid evolution, gravity, restart, public support or device qualification.

source_identity.note: Candidate has eleven source/test modifications on HEAD45b92535; all science/compile windows froze these bytes. Documentation follows testing. No claim of clean committed source.

implemented.layout: Existing CylindricalRZPhi; native r,z, three orthonormal momentum coefficients, resolved derivatives true,true,false.
implemented.Grid: Existing block shape/strides, one inactive storage cell and dx3=0. No extra field/cache. Finite nonnegative radial and finite positive axial domain; z has no angular-width restriction.
implemented.native_point: phi=0 embedding (r,0,z). Existing PointCoords populated; new Cyl2 uses hypot/atan2 to retain tiny nonzero point angles and negative axial coordinates. Retained eight charts keep operation order.

measures.W: dz integral r^2 dr = integral r dV

implemented.common_moments: AngularMomentumVolumeMoment/AngularMomentumFaceMoment in existing GridMetrics, using existing factored integrals. Cyl3 includes real dphi for full-volume convention; rphi remains per-unit transverse length with azimuthal face torque Q. Unsupported bases/directions return NaN.
implemented.sources: Cyl2 reads uphi from mom_w and supplies radial pressure+centrifugal source. angular_delta remains nullptr: the future compatible torque divergence absorbs phi curvature. Existing continuous leaf, rphi/Cyl3 source arithmetic and Cyl1 pressure-only behavior remain.
implemented.axis_parity: Existing coordinate seam uses layout azimuth, mirrors negative r, keeps z and inactive phi unchanged, signs(-,+,-), no phi shift/fmod for an unresolved angle. Existing angular charts retain full-turn rules.
implemented.Block_geometry: Existing exact logical geometry identity admits native Cyl2 for donor/block checks; no transfer, regrid or Tree-evolution qualification granted.
implemented.boundary_normals: Existing cylindrical normal formula already supplies e_r/e_z at phi=0; comments corrected, no new normal formula.
implemented.Hydro_safety: An explicit Cyl2 reject in the Host Hydro composition owner preserves preflight refusal now that low-level views are usable. Tested with a real solver before boundary authority callback.

support_matrix.native_geometry: Nine geometry/dimension combinations inspectable, including new Cyl2.
support_matrix.published_combinations: The existing eight remain. No Core/Studio schema or public configuration change.
support_matrix.limit: These are the actual public/composition gates, not a claim that every raw mathematical leaf refuses native Cyl2.

independent_geometry.reference: Decimal120 power integrals from actual binary64 endpoints, independent of production factored expressions.

verification.existing_shared_oracle: Twelve independent 70/90-digit fixture rows expanded within existing Host/device math fixture; complete existing geometry target maximum relative error3.03178e-16. CUDA consumption is source-only until executed later.

retained_eight.scope: Eight retained native layouts, physical points, measures, active spacing and nonzero momentum sources; not whole-application evolution.

axis_donors.actual_owner: Existing MemoryPool/Block/native InitGeometry and coordinate seam plan/executor; deliberately no unqualified AMR evolution Tree.
axis_donors.not_qualified: Coarse/fine conservative transfer, reflux/regrid/EOS publication and coupled AMR evolution remain CYL-2.

verification.O7_and_interface: Current-source input_resolution/runtime capability/checkpoint CTests passed unchanged standards. Explicit public-chart, invalid-domain, real-Hydro preflight and Tree-initialization negatives added to existing tests.
verification.architecture_audit: Existing tools/audit_architecture.py passed, exit0; no physics owner or resource ownership introduced into common geometry.
verification.new_angular_evolution: UNTESTED. W/T geometry is verified; original 1e-12 angular budget is unchanged and still requires a compatible Hydro/AMR/viscous update in CYL-2. No new RZ scientific trajectory or cost ratio is signed.

retained_production_ARCH.scope: Old retirement application retained, not rebuilt and cannot qualify CYL-1/CYL-2 current-source application behavior.
